Elena (partnerships): Heads-up: Platform intends to remove /v1/compat-proxy on 2026-05-15. Need partner outreach + transition plan.
Rajat (platform): We can replace with /v1/generate + header mapping. Propose: announce 2026-04-01, transparent gateway rewrites 2026-04-15, partner canary 2026-04-22, remove 2026-05-15.
Maya (integrations): I'll inventory impacted partners (marketplace listings, OEMs, SIs). Need exact header/param diffs to publish migration guide.
Sam (eng): Compat-proxy did KV-cache prefixing and accepted `compat=true`. New route preserves semantics but renames params. We'll ship small gateway shim for a limited window and provide SDK patches (py/js/go).
Elena (partnerships): Draft partner email + migration guide. Offer two paths: quick SDK patch or marketplace-hosted shim for partners needing longer runway.
VendorBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PLT-523 for shim + docs + outreach.
Maya (integrations): Pinged AcmeHW and CloudPartner for canary slots. Adding partner priority to tracker.
Sam (eng): Example snippet for partners included in docs.
Rajat (platform): I'll own canary dashboard and rollback toggle. Auto-fallback to legacy route if error rate > 10/min during canary.
Elena (partnerships): Next sync Tue 2026-03-30 09:30 PT. Tracker -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PLT-523 :thumbsup:
